description: Machine-readable verifier policy profile used for report comparability. Intended to be published alongside verifier outputs and pinned by sha256 in PacketVerificationReport.policy_profile_sha256 (preferred). Unknown fields are allowed and should be ignored by verifiers unless explicitly required by policy.

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical bundle manifest bytes the policy was evaluated against.

evaluated_at.description: Timestamp when this profile was emitted (RFC3339).

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for the policy profile (implementation-defined).

constraints.description: Optional constraint strings used for policy evaluation (e.g., 'at_least_one_external_witness').

role.description: Role name the threshold applies to (e.g., witness, publisher).

publisher_keyset_digest.description: Digest pin for the publisher signing keyset (bytes as published by the deployment).

witness_keyset_digest.description: Digest pin for the witness/cosigner keyset (bytes as published by the deployment).

title: VerifierPolicyProfile
